You are controlling OpenBB Workspace through tool calls.
This is an interactive eval. You will choose one tool call at a time.
After each tool call, you will receive the real tool result.
Return only valid JSON. Do not use Markdown or prose.

Response schema:
{"done": false, "tool": "tool_name", "args": {}}
or
{"done": true}

Use only allowed tools.
Tool names must exactly match allowed_tools. Do not call shell, container, browser, or developer tools.
When a tool asks for origin, use the display origin from origin_hints, not the fixture slug.
Use IDs returned by tool results exactly. Do not use placeholders like {{dashboard_id}}.
If dashboard_id is optional and you do not know the UUID, omit it instead of using a dashboard name.
Never invent widget_id values. Use exact widget_id values from list_available_widgets, widget_hints, or prior tool results.
Before create_widget, you MUST call list_available_widgets for the same origin when that tool is allowed.
Before create_widget, you MUST call get_widget_schema for the same origin and widget_id when that tool is allowed.
Calling create_widget before list_available_widgets and get_widget_schema will fail the benchmark.
For tabbed dashboards, navigate to the target tab before creating widgets or set layout tab_id correctly.
For app templates, call manage_backends list, then use the returned backend id in manage_apps.
For generated notes/charts, include concrete task facts from tool data and put the widget on the required tab when applicable.
Generated widget text is checked literally. Copy exact numbers and identifiers from observations: write 0.86, not 86%; write price_performance, not only Price Performance.
Use update_widget_layout for layout changes, not update_widget.
When the final Workspace state satisfies the task, return {"done": true}.
I'll start by inspecting the current workspace{"done": false, "tool": "get_workspace_snapshot", "args": {}}

Your last response could not be parsed as a single JSON action (Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)). Reply with exactly one JSON object: {"tool": "<name>", "args": {...}} or {"done": true} — no prose, no second object.

Now I'll create the backend with both widgets and the app definition in one call.{"done": false, "tool": "manage_backends", "args": {"operation": "add", "name": "Healthcare Research Data", "url": "http://localhost:7808", "widgets_json": {"pipeline_status_table": {"name": "Pipeline Status Table", "description": "Healthcare pipeline programs by phase.", "endpoint": "/pipeline-status-table", "type": "table", "gridData": {"w": 20, "h": 9}, "params": [{"paramName": "ticker", "type": "text", "label": "Ticker", "value": "PFE", "description": "Pipeline Status Table focus field."}], "data": {"table": {"columnsDefs": [{"field": "phase", "headerName": "Phase", "cellDataType": "text"}, {"field": "programs", "headerName": "Programs", "cellDataType": "number"}, {"field": "readout_date", "headerName": "Readout Date", "cellDataType": "dateString"}, {"field": "ticker", "headerName": "Ticker", "cellDataType": "text"}]}}}, "pipeline_chart": {"name": "Pipeline by Phase", "description": "Plotly pipeline distribution by phase.", "endpoint": "/pipeline-by-phase", "type": "chart", "gridData": {"w": 20, "h": 9}, "raw": true}}, "apps_json": [{"name": "Healthcare Pipeline", "description": "Pipeline table and phase chart.", "tabs": {"pipeline": {"id": "pipeline", "name": "Pipeline", "layout": [{"i": "pipeline_status_table", "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 20, "h": 9}]}, "phase": {"id": "phase", "name": "Phase", "layout": [{"i": "pipeline_chart", "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 20, "h": 9}]}}}]}}

{"done": false, "tool": "manage_backends", "args": {"operation": "add", "name": "Healthcare Research Data", "url": "http://localhost:7808", "widgets_json": {"pipeline_chart": {"description": "Plotly pipeline distribution by phase.", "endpoint": "/pipeline-by-phase", "gridData": {"h": 9, "w": 20}, "name": "Pipeline by Phase", "raw": true, "type": "chart"}, "pipeline_status_table": {"data": {"table": {"columnsDefs": [{"cellDataType": "text", "field": "phase", "headerName": "Phase"}, {"cellDataType": "number", "field": "programs", "headerName": "Programs"}, {"cellDataType": "dateString", "field": "readout_date", "headerName": "Readout Date"}, {"cellDataType": "text", "field": "ticker", "headerName": "Ticker"}]}}, "description": "Healthcare pipeline programs by phase.", "endpoint": "/pipeline-status-table", "gridData": {"h": 9, "w": 20}, "name": "Pipeline Status Table", "params": [{"description": "Pipeline Status Table focus field.", "label": "Ticker", "paramName": "ticker", "type": "text", "value": "PFE"}], "type": "table"}}, "apps_json": [{"description": "Pipeline table and phase chart.", "name": "Healthcare Pipeline", "tabs": {"phase": {"id": "phase", "layout": [{"h": 9, "i": "pipeline_chart", "w": 20, "x": 0, "y": 0}], "name": "Phase"}, "pipeline": {"id": "pipeline", "layout": [{"h": 9, "i": "pipeline_status_table", "w": 20, "x": 0, "y": 0}], "name": "Pipeline"}}}]}}
